en.name: Find a business opportunity
en.topic: AI-assisted trip planning for independent travelers
en.question: Which recurring planning task is painful enough to justify a real-world test?
en.decision: Test itinerary repair—turning a messy plan into a bookable day—before building an end-to-end travel planner.
en.why: A broad idea becomes one audience, one repeated task, and one bounded offer to validate.
collect: Repeated planning breakdowns and the words travelers use to describe them
Manual workarounds, abandoned attempts, and visible time or money costs
Representative comments that agree, qualify, or challenge the problem
en.counter: Free templates may solve the problem well enough, or the visible frustration may come from destination-specific complexity rather than a reusable need.
en.test: Offer itinerary repair to 10 opt-in travelers. Continue only if at least 3 use the repaired plan; stop if the same task does not repeat.
en.prompt: Use $trend-opportunity-radar to find business opportunities around AI-assisted trip planning for independent travelers on TikTok.

zh.name: 发现商业机会
zh.topic: 面向自由行用户的 AI 行程规划
zh.question: 哪个反复出现的规划难题，值得先做一次真实测试？
zh.decision: 先测试“把混乱行程修成可执行的一天”，不要一开始就做完整旅行规划器。
zh.why: 把宽泛想法收敛成一个人群、一个重复任务和一个可验证的小服务。
collect: 反复出现的规划中断，以及旅行者描述问题时使用的原话
人工替代方案、放弃过程，以及可见的时间或金钱成本
赞同、限定或反驳该问题的代表性评论
zh.counter: 免费模板可能已经足够，或者可见抱怨只是特定目的地太复杂，并不代表可复用需求。
zh.test: 向 10 位自愿参与者提供行程修复；至少 3 人实际采用修复方案才继续，否则停止扩展。
zh.prompt: 使用 $trend-opportunity-radar，分析“面向自由行用户的 AI 行程规划”在 TikTok 平台的商业机会。

en.name: Monitor brand sentiment
en.question: What needs a response now, and what should only be watched?
en.decision: Separate delivery-status anxiety from product-quality sentiment; improve proactive shipping updates before changing product messaging.
en.why: The report turns mixed mentions into response priorities without calling one complaint a trend.
collect: Verified public posts that describe a current experience, question, or request for help
Visible comments that show whether others share or dispute the issue
Positive experiences and unrelated delivery incidents as counterevidence
en.counter: A seasonal carrier delay may affect many brands, and a high-engagement complaint can still be an isolated incident.
en.test: Publish one proactive delivery-status update and compare the next bounded sample of support questions; do not claim sentiment recovery from fewer mentions alone.
en.prompt: Use $trend-opportunity-radar to monitor brand sentiment around Northstar Bags delivery conversations on Facebook.

zh.name: 监测品牌舆情
zh.topic: Northstar Bags 配送讨论（虚构品牌）
zh.question: 哪些问题现在需要回应，哪些只需要继续观察？
zh.decision: 先把配送状态焦虑与产品质量评价分开；优先改善主动物流通知，而不是立刻修改产品宣传。
zh.why: 把混杂的品牌提及整理成回应优先级，同时避免把单条投诉写成趋势。
collect: 描述当前体验、问题或求助的已核验公开帖子
能说明其他用户是否赞同或反驳该问题的可见评论
正面体验和与品牌无关的配送事故，作为反证
zh.counter: 季节性物流延迟可能影响多个品牌；高互动投诉也可能只是单一事件。
zh.test: 发布一次主动配送状态说明，再比较下一批有限样本中的求助问题；不能仅凭提及减少就声称舆情改善。
zh.prompt: 使用 $trend-opportunity-radar，监测 Northstar Bags 配送讨论在 Facebook 平台的品牌舆情。

en.name: Study competitor users
en.topic: Small teams switching away from established project tools
en.question: Why do users stay, complain, or switch—and which problem is reachable?
en.decision: Test a lightweight handoff log for small teams; do not compete on broad feature count.
en.why: Competitor complaints become a narrow product wedge only after stay reasons and counterexamples are reviewed.
collect: First-person switching stories with the previous tool, trigger, and current workaround
Reasons satisfied users stay, including integrations and organizational habit
Repeated comment themes separated from post-level trend volume
en.counter: Users may complain while remaining locked in by integrations, procurement, or team history; frustration does not prove willingness to switch.
en.test: Prototype one handoff log with 5 small teams and measure repeated weekly use, not stated interest.
en.prompt: Use $trend-opportunity-radar to study competitor users who are switching away from established project tools on Reddit.

zh.name: 研究竞品用户
zh.topic: 小团队为什么离开成熟项目管理工具
zh.question: 用户为什么留下、抱怨或切换，哪个问题真正可以切入？
zh.decision: 先测试面向小团队的轻量交接记录，不要用更多功能正面竞争。
zh.why: 只有同时检查留下原因和反例，竞品抱怨才能收敛成可信的产品切入口。
collect: 包含原工具、切换触发点和当前替代方案的第一人称经历
满意用户留下的原因，包括集成能力和组织习惯
反复出现的评论议题，并与帖子层趋势量分开
zh.counter: 用户可能一边抱怨，一边因为集成、采购或团队历史继续使用；不满不等于愿意切换。
zh.test: 让 5 个小团队试用一个交接记录原型，观察是否每周重复使用，而不是只记录口头兴趣。
zh.prompt: 使用 $trend-opportunity-radar，研究 Reddit 上“小团队为什么离开成熟项目管理工具”的竞品用户。

en.name: Find a content opportunity
en.topic: First-time travelers choosing an overseas hotel
en.question: Which repeated audience question deserves a useful piece of content next?
en.decision: Create a saveable checklist that compares neighborhood, transit, and cancellation before price.
en.why: The output prioritizes a user decision and proof format, not merely a popular keyword.
collect: Repeated questions in post captions and representative comments
Content formats users save, revisit, or ask to expand
Existing posts that already answer the question well
en.counter: High saves may reflect attractive templates rather than unresolved decision difficulty; the platform sample does not prove search demand.
en.test: Publish one checklist and one narrative comparison with the same decision scope; compare qualified follow-up questions, not views alone.
en.prompt: Use $trend-opportunity-radar to find content opportunities around first-time travelers choosing an overseas hotel on Xiaohongshu.

zh.name: 寻找内容机会
zh.topic: 第一次出国旅行时如何选择酒店
zh.question: 用户反复在问的哪个问题，最值得下一篇内容认真回答？
zh.decision: 先做一份可收藏的清单：在比较价格前，先比较区域、交通和取消政策。
zh.why: 输出优先选择用户要做的决定和适合的证明形式，而不是只挑一个热门关键词。
collect: 帖子文案与代表性评论中反复出现的问题
用户会收藏、回看或要求展开的内容形式
已经把该问题回答得很好的现有内容
zh.counter: 高收藏可能只是模板好看，不代表决策问题没有被解决；平台样本也不能证明搜索需求。
zh.test: 围绕同一决策分别发布一份清单和一篇叙事对比，比较有价值的后续提问，而不是只看浏览量。
zh.prompt: 使用 $trend-opportunity-radar，分析“第一次出国旅行时如何选择酒店”在小红书平台的内容机会。

en.name: Validate product demand
en.topic: An AI assistant that reduces repetitive support replies for small online shops
en.question: Does a repeated user task justify a bounded MVP test?
en.decision: Validate reply drafting for order-status questions before attempting autonomous customer support.
en.why: The study separates a recurring task from general AI enthusiasm and ends with a measurable MVP boundary.
collect: First-person descriptions of repeated support work and current manual handling
Consequences such as delayed replies, owner workload, or inconsistent answers
Cases where templates, help centers, or existing tools already solve the task
en.counter: Small shops may have too little ticket volume, or trust and integration costs may outweigh saved drafting time.
en.test: Run a human-approved drafting pilot for order-status questions. Continue only if operators repeatedly accept or lightly edit the drafts.
en.prompt: Use $trend-opportunity-radar to validate product demand for an AI assistant that reduces repetitive support replies for small online shops on X.

zh.name: 验证产品需求
zh.topic: 帮助小网店减少重复售后回复的 AI 助手
zh.question: 反复出现的用户任务，是否值得做一个边界清晰的 MVP 测试？
zh.decision: 先验证订单状态问题的回复草稿，不要直接尝试全自动客服。
zh.why: 把真实重复任务与泛化的 AI 兴趣分开，并用可衡量的 MVP 边界结束研究。
collect: 经营者对重复售后工作和当前人工处理方式的第一人称描述
回复延迟、店主工作量或回答不一致等实际后果
模板、帮助中心或现有工具已经能解决问题的情况
zh.counter: 小店工单量可能太少，或者信任与集成成本高于节省的草稿时间。
zh.test: 对订单状态问题进行人工确认的回复草稿试点；只有经营者反复采用或只做轻微修改时才继续。
zh.prompt: 使用 $trend-opportunity-radar，分析“帮助小网店减少重复售后回复的 AI 助手”在 X 平台的产品需求。
